title: Keep unsatisfied requirements typed in `SitePackages`
body:
## Summary

Return structured requirements from `SitePackages` satisfaction checks instead of converting unsatisfied requirements to strings. This lets callers inspect the requirement or include it in a typed error, while formatting it only when reporting a diagnostic.

Preparatory refactor for #21880.
